intro: Follow one request as it travels from your keyboard to a running program.

steps.explanation: You describe three copies of your website in a short file and send it off.
steps.label: State your wish

steps.explanation: The front door checks the request and writes the plan into reliable memory.
steps.label: Plan is recorded

steps.explanation: The scheduler picks a machine with enough free room for each copy.
steps.label: Work finds a home

steps.explanation: The machine starts the programs, and caretakers keep the count at three.
steps.label: Programs start running

steps.explanation: Visitors reach one steady address no matter which machine answers.
steps.label: Visitors arrive safely

takeaways: You declare the result, the cluster handles the steps.
Every part has one job: record, place, watch, or run.
Failed copies are replaced without visitors noticing.
title: From your wish to a running app
